description: This file defines the `InstanceInfo` data structure and manages the `InstancesStore` class responsible for tracking and updating instances' presence data, handling network requests, and managing notifications related to node connectivity within an open-claw-related macOS application.

classes.name: InstancesStore
classes.description: A singleton class that manages the collection of `InstanceInfo` objects, handles refreshing presence data, processes real-time presence events, manages notifications for node connections, and maintains internal state related to instances' status and health checks.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates periodic presence refresh and sets up event subscriptions if not in preview mode.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Terminates ongoing presence refresh and event subscription tasks.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Performs asynchronous request to fetch presence data from the control channel, updates internal instances list, handles errors, and triggers health probes if needed.

methods.name: localFallbackInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a fallback `InstanceInfo` representing the local machine, used when presence data is unavailable.

methods.name: handlePresenceEventPayload
methods.description: Decodes and applies presence payloads received from real-time push events.

methods.name: normalizePresence
methods.description: Converts raw presence entries into a list of `InstanceInfo` objects with unique IDs for internal tracking.

methods.name: applyPresence
methods.description: Updates the internal instances list based on decoded presence entries and triggers notifications for new node connections.

methods.name: notifyOnNodeLogin
methods.description: Sends user notifications when a new node connection is detected, avoiding duplicates and filtering local modes.

methods.name: decodeAndApplyPresenceData
methods.description: Decodes presence data and applies it to update the internal state.

methods.name: probeHealthIfNeeded
methods.description: Performs a health check on the gateway control channel and optionally adds health status info to instances list.

methods.name: snippet
methods.description: Creates a string snippet of raw data payloads for logging purposes.
